prerequisite.rule: V034 acceptance cannot promote or release while V033-7 is not PASS on one exact candidate.

freeze.dataPolicy: Synthetic fixtures only. Do not capture PHI, PII, credentials, ID tokens, prescription images, or production data.

baseline.comparison: Existing v0.33.2 patient flow without the candidate timeline and upload-recovery changes.
baseline.claimBoundary: The baseline is identified but no real-device timing or success-rate measurement has been performed.

participants.attributes: Adult patient selecting their own synthetic profile and using standard text size.
Family member selecting a separately owned synthetic family profile without changing the authenticated LINE owner.
Older adult using 200% text/zoom and assistive technology where available.

tasks.start: Open the pharmacy LIFF main menu with synthetic owned history.
tasks.successDefinition: The participant finds 利用状況, identifies the latest server-owned status and next action, and opens the fixed matching detail route without viewing another owner's data.
tasks.failureDefinition: The participant opens the wrong domain, cannot identify the next action, reaches an unsafe or broken destination, sees another owner's item, or needs facilitator intervention.

tasks.start: Open 処方せん事前送信 with synthetic self and family profiles available.
tasks.successDefinition: The participant selects the intended profile, adds 1-4 synthetic images, completes both consents and confirmation, sends once, and understands that 受付内容の確認待ち is not 薬局受付済み.
tasks.failureDefinition: Wrong-patient selection, missing consent, duplicate mutation, input loss, unclear received-versus-accepted state, critical validation miss, or facilitator intervention.

tasks.start: Begin a synthetic upload, then inject offline, timeout, reload, back navigation, or LINE WebView restart before the outcome is known.
tasks.successDefinition: The participant returns to the owned draft, sees ready versus missing work, reselects only needed images, reconfirms consent, and completes without duplicate submission or PHI browser persistence.
tasks.failureDefinition: Blind mutation retry, duplicate submission, unrecoverable input loss, wrong-owner recovery, stale patient binding, PHI persistence, or inability to reach a safe status screen.

environments.required: Current supported iOS hardware and LINE in-app WebView
Current supported Android hardware and LINE in-app WebView

accessibilityChecks: Focus order follows the visual task order.
Validation and recovery errors identify the problem and move focus to the alert or affected field.
Loading, success, received, accepted, offline, and recovery state changes are announced.
Controls remain operable and readable at 200% text or zoom without hidden primary actions.
Text and controls retain sufficient contrast in LINE WebView and low-contrast viewing conditions.
All task controls have an accessible name, role, state, and at least a 44px target.

acceptance.primaryRule: Every zero-tolerance count must be 0 and every required environment/task combination must complete without facilitator intervention before PASS.
acceptance.auxiliaryRule: Time and success-rate targets are descriptive only and cannot override a safety, ownership, correctness, or accessibility failure.
